about: Discounted totals are cut down to the minor unit instead of rounded half up; no public test sees it.

mutations.find:
// What a whole-percentage discount leaves of an amount, rounded half up to the minor unit, in integers only.
export const discounted = (minor, percent) => Math.floor((minor * (100 - percent) + 50) / 100);
mutations.replace:
// What a whole-percentage discount leaves of an amount, in minor units, in integers only.
export const discounted = (minor, percent) => Math.floor((minor * (100 - percent)) / 100);
